governance: This registry describes software behavior only. It is not clinical approval. A designated clinical lead must approve the exact source edition, scoring rules, licensing, local thresholds and implementation before operational use.

tools.notes: No individual outcome prediction or treatment decision from total alone.
Total scoring disabled pending confirmation of official edition, scoring table and permission.
Current UI captures 13 score-bearing observations only; full instrument structure and license must be reviewed before total scoring.
No composite clinical stage is inferred by the application.
Use only for pressure injury and by trained clinician using current official definitions.
Grade and stage remain separate; no automatic inference.

input_validation_note: Numeric ranges in clinical-validation-v30.js are software input plausibility checks only. They are not reference ranges, diagnostic cutoffs, or treatment thresholds.
